chunks: We have brought to you the truth, but most of you despise the truth.
ai.seo_question: Why do most people reject the truth even when it is clearly presented to them?
ai.summary: In Surah Az-Zukhruf, this verse underscores the persistent human tendency toward stubbornness (istikbar) even when presented with clear, undeniable truth. Shia exegesis often links this to the rejection of the Ahl al-Bayt, illustrating how the majority may reject divine authority due to attachment to worldly status or ancestral traditions. It serves as a reminder that acceptance of truth requires not just intellectual recognition but also humility and willingness to submit.
